# The Natural Parent Magazine

> A quarterly parenting magazine available through print subscriptions, retail stockists across Australia, New Zealand, and the UK, and professional distribution programs for healthcare providers.

The Natural Parent Magazine serves parents and healthcare professionals across the Commonwealth with natural parenting content through multiple distribution channels including direct subscriptions, retail locations, and professional programs.

## Key Topics

- Print subscription
- Quarterly publication
- Natural parenting
- Retail stockists
- Magazine distribution
- Midwife subscription

## Subscriptions & Products

- [Print Subscription](https://thenaturalparentmagazine.com/product/print-subscription): Print subscription options for The Natural Parent Magazine quarterly publication
- [Midwife Subscription - New Zealand](https://thenaturalparentmagazine.com/midwife-subscription-nz): Free magazine distribution program for midwives and healthcare professionals in NZ
- [Midwife Subscription - United Kingdom](https://thenaturalparentmagazine.com/midwife-subscription-uk): Free magazine distribution program for midwives and healthcare professionals in UK
